episodes.synopsis: A stranger breaks into the temple, defeating everyone who faces him by himself. He's after the sword - "Kenkaranpu". But why is he so desperate to get it? And will Taitou and his sister be able to stop him?
episodes.title: The Destroyed Army's Howling Engraving

episodes.synopsis: The fight continues with the mysterious enemy, and the big adventure truly begins.
episodes.title: Military Song of Karma

episodes.synopsis: The group visit a small town with a huge boulder looming dangerously over the cliff above it. But that's not the only danger, the goverment officals are corrupt and don't care about the people. Will the group be able to stop both? And who is "Koyo"?
episodes.title: Honorable Pledge

episodes.synopsis: The group meets a strange boy, all the arrows and bows he use explode because of the energy put into them. Who exactly is he and which side is he on?
episodes.title: The Five Divine Warriors

episodes.synopsis: The group meet some orphans, who have to steal to live. Unfortunately, they've angered some thugs who are known to kill anyone who try and face them. Will the group be able to protect the orphans?
episodes.title: The Diseased Empire

episodes.synopsis: Hosei feels ignored when his master takes a special interest in training Taito, so the young archer picks a fight with a gang of bandits who refuse to die - no matter how many times he kills them!
episodes.title: Crimson Hero

episodes.synopsis: Hosei's rash behavior causes his master to become an undead servant of evil. With his new friends' lives on the line, will he be able to obey her chilling final order?
episodes.title: The Sorrow of the Rokuson

episodes.synopsis: Sensing Hosei's pain over the loss of his master, the heroes embark on a mission to lift his spirits. While Taito and Ryuko try their luck as hunters, Laila collects mushrooms in an attempt to conjure up something edible.
episodes.title: Echoes in the Valley..

episodes.synopsis: The empire undergoes frightening changes after Keiro stakes his claim to the throne. When the former emperor is imprisoned, Taito and company must act quickly to save him.
episodes.title: The Shadows Cast Upon the Capital

episodes.synopsis: Spurred by delusions of grandeur, Taito infiltrates the royal palace, determined to teach the emperor how to run a country - or claim the throne for himself!
episodes.title: The Lonely Emperor

episodes.synopsis: Lord Keiro's grotesque appetite for power turned him into a bloodthirsty monster. Only Taito can stop him, but he'll need to draw strength from his friends to survive the final showdown!
episodes.title: Hokushinkiki

episodes.synopsis: Ryuko seeks the council of his elders as he struggles to determine his role in the prophesized battle, and Chouka makes an aggressive attempt to eliminate Taito.
episodes.title: The Moonlight`s Sparkle

episodes.synopsis: When Taito and Keiro meet again on the field of battle, Ryuko must decide whether he will fight alongside his friend - or his father!
